messages:
leah.peopleops: Heads-up team 0: open enrollment window published in handbook this morning. Changes: 1) pre-tax dependent care enrollment dates clarified, 2) new voluntary commuter benefit option, 3) updated FAQ for mid-cycle elections. Please review and ACK by 2026-11-15. Handbook diff: https://internal.redwood/handbook/changes/1772001234.

meera-hr: Quick note 0: the commuter benefit requires payroll setup — opt-in must be submitted by payroll cutoff listed in the handbook. EU/UK employees: local tax rules may apply, see footnote in the doc.

emily-benefits: Payroll note: if employees need retroactive deductions for Nov, submit names + signed form by 2026-11-12 to payroll@redwood. Also adding a short manager script for questions.

tom-payroll: Confirmed. Payroll will accept the CSV export from the benefits portal; please ensure names match legal name on file.

alex-recruiting: For new hires starting mid-Nov: will they see the open enrollment in their welcome packet?

onboarding-bot: Auto-rule: new hires with start_date <= 2026-11-30 will receive the enrollment packet and benefit links in day 1 onboarding email. Link: https://training.redwood/assign/enrollment-2026.

compliance-bot: Reminder: Mandatory acknowledgment of handbook changes assigned to all active staff. Due 2026-11-20. Weekly digest will be sent to managers every Fri. Completion report to be sent 2026-11-21.

leah.peopleops: Managers: please add a 5-min ack item to your next team sync and confirm here once done. We're also running a live 20-min drop-in on Thursday 10am PT for Q&A; I'll post slides after.

meera-hr: Contractors: commuter benefit not available. Contractors touching payroll data must complete the "Contractor Data Handling" micro-course and sign the CDA. Recruiting, please flag such contractors in the contractor tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/contractor-tracker.

emily-benefits: I've uploaded the FAQ and sample enrollment screenshots to the benefits drive. If anyone wants a short blurb to include in offer letters, ping me.

alex-recruiting: Will add a note to `templates/offer-letter.md` avoiding guarantees about open enrollment eligibility for contractors. PR after ack window.

leah.peopleops: I'll export the ack+completion CSV on 2026-11-21 and follow up with teams under 90%. If you have edge cases (leave overlap, new payroll details), tag @tom-payroll or DM me.
